highlights.title: Chinese AI company Zhipu claims its new is a better bug-finder than Anthropic, OpenAI
highlights.description: PLUS: HCL, TCS, admit data breaches; Google, Apple, India bans some rideshare tips; and more!

highlights.title: AI Era Demands More Agile Leaders, Harvard’s Linda Hill Says
highlights.description: The next generation of chief executives will need to spend more time building flexible organizations as the deployment of artificial intelligence rapidly reshapes how companies do business, according to Harvard Business School Professor Linda Hill.

highlights.title: Lynk and Omnispace form Elveo Mobile to advance D2D services
highlights.description:
Lynk Global has completed its merger with Omnispace and rebranded as Elveo Mobile, adding globally coordinated S-band spectrum to expand direct-to-device satellite services beyond basic messaging.
The post Lynk and Omnispace form Elveo Mobile to advance D2D services appeared first on SpaceNews.

highlights.title: Alibaba to Sell Gaming Arm for $1.5 Billion in Boost to AI Pivot
highlights.description: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. is selling its gaming arm in a deal worth at least $1.5 billion that will boost the Chinese e-commerce leader’s pivot to AI.

highlights.title: HSG-Backed Robotera Is Said to Mull HK IPO as Robot Tech Booms
highlights.description: Robotera, a Chinese robotics startup backed by HSG and CDH Investments, is planning an initial public offering in Hong Kong, people familiar with the matter said, as a growing number of companies in the industry look to go public.

highlights.title: Final UI for Googlebook ‘Desktop Camera’ app revealed [Gallery]
highlights.description: Ahead of the Googlebook launch this fall, we now have a full look at the Desktop Camera application.

highlights.title: Microsoft blames AI for delayed Exchange update, can’t say when it will arrive
highlights.description: Dealing with machine-made bug backlog makes it hard to find a moment to deliver promised subscription service

highlights.title: Another woman joins lawsuit accusing Grok of generating CSAM
highlights.description: A fourth party is pursuing legal action against xAI, alleging that Grok was used to create CSAM based on her childhood photos.
